cli.intro: OpenViewer — inspect local images, read metadata and render PNG previews or thumbnails.

cmd.info: Print format, dimensions, colour type and file size for one image
cmd.thumbnail: Render a PNG thumbnail that fits inside --max without upscaling
cmd.capabilities: Print platform capabilities, including unavailable states
cmd.audit: Print the append-only capability audit history as JSON lines
cmd.install: Plan an install or upgrade, and optionally apply it
cmd.uninstall: Plan a removal, and optionally apply it

opt.max: Maximum thumbnail edge in pixels (1-8192, default 1024)
opt.dryRun: Render and measure the thumbnail without writing a file
opt.apply: Apply the printed plan instead of only planning
opt.noShortcut: Do not plan a per-user launcher
opt.resetConfig: Replace an existing configuration with defaults
opt.keepConfig: Keep the user configuration during uninstall
opt.title: GUI window title
opt.actor: Actor id recorded for every capability call (default: WAE_ACTOR_ID)
opt.actorKind: Actor kind: user or agent (default: WAE_ACTOR_KIND)
opt.actorSource: Actor entry point, for example cli, gui, plugin (default: cli)
opt.filterActor: Only show audit records for this actor id
opt.filterKind: Only show audit records for this actor kind
opt.capability: Only show audit records for this capability name
